title: Game polish: world deco, barriers, UI animations, effects, pet glow, bug fixes
description: Comprehensive polish pass to make Battle Pets feel juicy like Pet Simulator 1. Adds procedural world decoration (trees/rocks/flowers for Zone 1, street lamps/benches for Zone 2), invisible barriers at zone edges, smooth UI panel tween animations, improved HP bars, level-up celebration effect, improved currency popups, rarity-based pet glow/particles, and bug fixes found during code review.
steps: Add procedural world decoration to ZoneService: trees, rocks, flowers in Zone 1; street lamps, benches in Zone 2
Add invisible wall barriers at the edges of both zones to prevent falling off
Improve UIController toggleScreen to use Tween slide-in/slide-out animations instead of instant show/hide
Improve EffectsController HP bars: bigger, more colorful, floating higher with HP text
Add level-up celebration effect in EffectsController: golden LEVEL UP text + particle ring
Improve currency popups in EffectsController: fly upward with scale animation and fade
Add rarity-based glow/particles to pet models in PetController (Common=white dim, Uncommon=green, Rare=blue, Epic=purple, Legendary=gold strong)
Fix CurrencyUpdated event payload mismatch (server sends table, client expects two args)
acceptance_criteria: Zone 1 has procedural decoration (trees, rocks, flowers) spawned by ZoneService
Zone 2 has procedural decoration (street lamps, benches) spawned by ZoneService
Invisible barriers prevent players from falling off zone edges
UI panels slide in/out with Tween animations instead of appearing instantly
HP bars are larger (120x24), have HP text overlay, and float higher (4 studs)
Level-up shows a golden LEVEL UP! text with expanding particle ring
Currency popups fly upward with scale-in animation and smooth fadeout
Pets have rarity-colored glow particles (PointLight brightness varies by rarity)
Event payload mismatches are fixed (CurrencyUpdated, UpgradeUpdated, CampaignVictory)
BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx regenerated successfully and is valid XML
findings: All improvements implemented successfully. Verified: (1) CurrencyService already sends two positional args (coins, diamonds) matching the client handler - the v3 review bug was already fixed in a prior commit. (2) UpgradeUpdated sends full data.upgrades table matching client expectation. (3) CampaignVictory client handler already accepts (levelNum, rewards). No event payload mismatches remain. New features: world decoration creates 12 trees, 8 rocks, 20 flower clusters in Zone 1; 10 street lamps, 8 benches, 6 planters in Zone 2. Barriers are 40-stud tall invisible walls on all outer edges. UI panels use Back easing slide animation. HP bars are 120x24 with gradient, text overlay, and hit-shake. Level-up triggers golden text + 16 expanding particle ring. Currency popups scale in with Back easing then float and fade. Pets get brightness-scaled PointLight and orbiting Neon particles for Rare+.
